mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pk_lender_product_list_latest ( profile_id, credit_application_id, mobile_no, apply_id, credit_apply_no, lender_user_id, credit_status, product_status, last_lender_request_json, last_lender_response_json, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{profileId}, #{creditApplicationId}, #{mobileNo}, #{applyId}, #{creditApplyNo}, #{lenderUserId}, #{creditStatus}, #{productStatus}, #{lastLenderRequestJson}, #{lastLenderResponseJson}, #{fetchedAt, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_id = VALUES(profile_id), mobile_no = VALUES(mobile_no), apply_id = VALUES(apply_id), credit_apply_no = VALUES(credit_apply_no), lender_user_id = VALUES(lender_user_id), credit_status = VALUES(credit_status), product_status = VALUES(product_status), last_lender_request_json = VALUES(last_lender_request_json), last_lender_response_json = VALUES(last_lender_response_json), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE ur FROM pk_lender_product_uneven_rate_latest ur INNER JOIN pk_lender_product_repay_method_latest rm ON ur.repay_method_latest_id = rm.id INNER JOIN pk_lender_product_latest p ON rm.product_latest_id = p.id WHERE p.product_list_latest_id = #{listLatestId}
DELETE rm FROM pk_lender_product_repay_method_latest rm INNER JOIN pk_lender_product_latest p ON rm.product_latest_id = p.id WHERE p.product_list_latest_id = #{listLatestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pk_lender_product_latest ( product_list_latest_id, mobile_no, product_code, product_name, min_amount, max_amount, comprehensive_rate_unit, comprehensive_rate, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{productListLatestId}, #{mobileNo}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{comprehensiveRateUnit}, #{comprehensiveRate}, #{sortOrder} )

INSERT INTO pk_lender_product_repay_method_latest ( product_latest_id, mobile_no, repay_method, cycle_type, cycle_interval, cycle_count, total_cycle_interval, repay_method_type, uneven_bills_repayment_rate_json, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{productLatestId}, #{mobileNo}, #{repayMethod}, #{cycleType}, #{cycleInterval}, #{cycleCount}, #{totalCycleInterval}, #{repayMethodType}, #{unevenBillsRepaymentRateJson}, #{sortOrder} )

INSERT INTO pk_lender_product_uneven_rate_latest ( repay_method_latest_id, mobile_no, term_num, repayment_rate, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{repayMethodLatestId}, #{mobileNo}, #{termNum}, #{repaymentRate}, #{sortOrder} )
